faq.question: Q1. What are the posts available in BBMB Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Bhakra Beas Management Board (BBMB) is recruiting for Lineman Apprentice and Electrician Apprentice posts, offering valuable apprenticeship opportunities.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are there in BBMB Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There are a total of 6 vacancies for Lineman Apprentice and Electrician Apprentice positions across various categories.

faq.question: Q3. What is the last date to apply for BBMB Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The last date to submit the hard copy of the application form for these posts is 10 August 2026.

faq.question: Q4. What is the application mode for BBMB Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Candidates need to apply offline by downloading the application form and sending the completed form along with required documents by post.

faq.question: Q5. What is the required qualification for these posts?
faq.answer: Candidates must have an ITI Pass qualification from a recognized institution to be eligible for these apprentice positions.

faq.question: Q6. Is there any application fee for BBMB Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee mentioned for any category (General/OBC, SC/ST) for this recruitment, making it accessible to all eligible candidates.

faq.question: Q7. What is the selection process for BBMB Apprentice posts?
faq.answer: The selection process will be based on a Merit List derived from the hard copy applications submitted by the candidates.

faq.question: Q8. Where is the job location for BBMB Apprentice Recruitment?
faq.answer: The job location for these apprentice posts is Hisar, Haryana, providing opportunities in the region.

faq.question: Q9. How can I download the application form?
faq.answer: You can download the application form from the official website of Bhakra Beas Management Board once the notification is released.

faq.question: Q10. What is the job type for these BBMB posts?
faq.answer: These positions are contractual in nature, specifically for apprentice roles, offering practical training and experience.
